zh-CN.title: 牌桌体验升级
items: 斗地主、双扣、麻将和数字交锋加入各自的背景音乐与语音提示，倒计时移到玩家座位。
斗地主和双扣支持划选手牌。玩法中可查看牌面、牌型和数字猜测示例。
对局中收到聊天消息会在顶部提示，确认离开正在进行的对局后会判负。

en.title: A better game table
items: Dou Dizhu, Shuangkou, Mahjong and Code Duel now have table music, voice cues and seat-side timers.
Drag across cards in Dou Dizhu and Shuangkou. Illustrated guides explain ranks, combinations and how to read a guess.
Chat notifications appear at the top of a match. Leaving an active match requires confirmation and counts as a loss.
